name: reels-generator
description: Local generator for vertical Indonesian educational videos (Remotion)

scripts.still: remotion still src/index.ts DockerWhiteboard out/still-whiteboard.png --frame=90 && remotion still src/index.ts DockerPresenter out/still-presenter.png --frame=240 && remotion still src/index.ts DockerCode out/still-code.png --frame=240
scripts.render:all: npm run render:whiteboard && npm run render:presenter && npm run render:code
